briefing: Defense supply chains, data-center power and deployable manufacturing dominated the week. The strongest commercialization signals came from systems integration—not stand-alone material launches—while 2D semiconductor and thermal research continued to widen the competitive field.

articles.title_original: Skeleton Technologies partners with DG Matrix on 800V DC power for AI data centers
articles.title_en: Skeleton and DG Matrix target 800V DC power architectures for AI data centers
articles.excerpt_original: Skeleton will integrate high-power, fast-response storage across DG Matrix's solid-state transformer platform.
articles.summary_en: Skeleton Technologies will integrate its Curved Graphene-based supercapacitors and SuperBattery systems with DG Matrix’s Interport solid-state transformer platform. The partnership positions graphene-enabled storage as a response layer for the repetitive pulse loads created by GPU clusters.

articles.title_original: Lyten's graphene-enhanced filament to be integrated into Modovolo's transportable 3D printing platform
articles.title_en: Lyten’s graphene filament moves into deployable large-format manufacturing
articles.excerpt_original: The companies plan to integrate graphene-enhanced PA1205 filament into a modular, transportable large-format printer.
articles.summary_en: Lyten and Modovolo are pairing graphene-enhanced PA1205 filament with a containerized large-format printing system developed for aviation, industrial, motorsports and defense uses. The combination points to field-deployable production of high-performance components and shorter domestic supply chains.

articles.title_original: HydroGraph calls on US policymakers to designate graphene a critical material
articles.title_en: HydroGraph pushes for US critical-material status and defense qualification programs
articles.excerpt_original: The company argues that domestic graphene production could reduce exposure to foreign-controlled graphite supplies.
articles.summary_en: HydroGraph asked US policymakers to designate graphene under the Defense Production Act and fund qualification pilots. Its case emphasizes a US hydrocarbon-gas feedstock route that avoids mined graphite, tying production technology directly to defense-industrial supply resilience.

articles.title_original: Mackenzie Fly Fishing reports tick-repellent properties in graphene-infused clothing range
articles.title_en: Mackenzie reports a functional textile benefit from graphene-infused clothing
articles.excerpt_original: The company says an outdoor test led to the discovery of tick-repellent behavior without chemical treatment.
articles.summary_en: Mackenzie Fly Fishing launched graphene-infused clothing that it says repels ticks without a chemical treatment. The claim is commercially interesting for outdoor and protective textiles, but independent test details were not provided in the source and require follow-up.

articles.title_original: Volt Carbon and TensorOne to test graphene-enhanced lithium metal batteries on autonomous drones
articles.title_en: Volt Carbon battery technology enters autonomous drone evaluation
articles.excerpt_original: The parties plan engineering validation, laboratory and flight testing, manufacturing evaluation and commercialization work.
articles.summary_en: Volt Carbon, Solid Ultrabattery and TensorOne agreed to evaluate graphene-enhanced lithium-metal batteries for autonomous and counter-UAS platforms. The work includes flight testing and manufacturing assessment, making this a direct defense qualification signal rather than an early laboratory collaboration.

articles.title_original: Adisyn reports verified graphene deposition repeatability and a US patent allowance
articles.title_en: Adisyn pairs repeatable sub-300°C deposition with a US patent allowance
articles.excerpt_original: Continuous graphene formation on copper was independently verified using an industrial ALD system below 300°C.
articles.summary_en: Adisyn reported independent verification of repeatable graphene deposition through subsidiary 2D Generation, alongside a US patent allowance covering core coating technology. The below-300°C process is aimed at compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing thermal limits.

articles.title_original: Interfacial nano-engineering of MXene-enhanced carbon fiber composites for safer type V hydrogen tanks
articles.title_en: MXene-enhanced composites target safer linerless hydrogen tanks
articles.excerpt_original: The work evaluates MXene-enhanced carbon-fiber/epoxy composites across mechanical, thermal and gas-barrier performance.
articles.summary_en: Researchers evaluated MXene-enhanced carbon-fiber composites for Type V hydrogen pressure vessels, combining experimental characterization with finite-element modelling. The work represents a non-graphene competitive route for multifunctional structural, barrier and thermal performance.

articles.title_original: Air-cooled battery thermal management system integrated with bionic shark structures based on PEG1500/EG/BN/TPE flexible composite
articles.title_en: Boron-nitride phase-change composite advances flexible battery thermal management
articles.excerpt_original: The system combines an air-cooled architecture, bionic flow structures and a flexible boron-nitride phase-change composite.
articles.summary_en: A battery thermal-management design published July 23 combines bionic air-flow structures with a flexible boron-nitride phase-change composite. It is a direct non-graphene benchmark for electrically insulating heat spreading and temperature buffering.

articles.title_original: Graphene transistor integrated with insect olfactory receptor enables selective detection of small organic compounds
articles.title_en: Graphene transistor and insect receptor form a selective organic-compound sensor
articles.excerpt_original: The team screened 6,655 wafer-scale graphene transistor devices before integrating a stable insect olfactory receptor.
articles.summary_en: A UC San Diego-led team combined an insect olfactory receptor with a liquid-gated graphene field-effect transistor. The large device-screening dataset and receptor stability make the work notable for moving bioelectronic sensing toward repeatable device fabrication.
